title: Chapter 277 Saido No Moriomi
content:
Chapter 277 Saido No Moriomi

Put the time back to a month ago.

On that day, the five masters who survived fighting for the long sword, and the disciples who guarded them.

Dazzled by the benefits of the blood sword, and bewitched by a little bit of blood spatter, under the siege of more than five thousand knight-errants who had long been unable to hold back, the entire army died!

Afterwards, the extermination of the master and the rest of their party members started a battle on the other side around the ownership of the blood sword.

This time, they were all second-rate characters, and they couldn't resist the blood sword's bewitching. They were soon bewitched by the blood sword and turned into ferocious beasts who only knew how to kill.

Next, more than 5,000 scattered people from the Jianghu followed in the footsteps of those 100 masters, and all of them killed each other, leaving no casualties.

In the middle, some people who regained their sanity and understood the surrounding situation fled far away in panic, which was regarded as a small life.

As for the rest, they fought to the end. When there were only a dozen or so people left, there were not many targets around, and the potential of the body was exhausted. They only woke up when they were unable to fight.

When they woke up, they were basically crazy, completely delirious lunatics, and they also had a tyrannical attribute hidden, thinking about killing people from time to time.

Only one or two sober people, after discussing with each other, think that if this continues, no one will get it, and there is a danger of falling.

So they formed an alliance with each other and agreed to escort the blood sword to Yuguo together, and the two shared the rewards equally and shared the country.

Afterwards, the two of them took the blood sword that was properly sealed and tightly protected, and barely isolated from the bewitching power, and embarked on a treasure-giving journey.

Of course, with the weak strength of these two people, and they haven't reached the first-class cultivation level, how can they protect such a shocking and peerless treasure.

So of course, before they left the territory of South Korea, they heard the news that the people who rushed over were robbed and killed, and their bodies were in different places.

Afterwards, the long sword continued on its journey to the Imperial Kingdom.

Some of them want to win the long sword and use his power to enhance their cultivation, while others want to exchange the long sword for wealth and land.

Generally speaking, there are more people in the latter category.

Along the way, on the way to Liaoyang City in Liaodong for nearly a thousand miles, I don't know how many bones were bought.

Especially many later people did not know that this blood sword can confuse people's hearts and turn people into monsters who only know how to kill, so many people accidentally fell for the way of the blood sword.

Those people had just acquired the Blood Sword, and they originally wanted to use him to gain power, or to exchange for wealth, but before they had time to be happy, they became demons that everyone could get and punish, killing everywhere.

Later, many righteous men were attracted, with the intention of doing justice for the sky and killing demons and demons. I don't know how many knights with justice in their hearts were sacrificed to barely kill this monster.

Then, before the righteous party had time to breathe a sigh of relief, they discovered that the young knight-errant who they had originally regarded as the savior had suddenly turned into a devil, and in turn hacked them off guard and fled.

In this way, due to the strange power of the blood sword, countless people were killed or injured in the entire rivers and lakes.

In addition to the loss of 100,000 Jianghu tycoons before, half of the world's Jianghu power was lost. The remaining half of the power, also because of the continuous damage and consumption of the blood sword, gradually couldn't make any waves anymore.

On the way Xue Jian set foot on the territory of Yuguo, he passed through the five kingdoms of South Korea, Weiguo, Qiguo, Zhaoguo, and Yanguo, and traveled thousands of miles.

In fact, it didn't need to take such a long journey, but those who held the blood sword, in order to avoid the eyes and ears of other interested people, kept hiding and hiding to find another way, which cost such a tortuous journey.

And along the way, because of the appearance of the blood sword, the forces in the rivers and lakes within the five countries can be said to have suffered a devastating blow.

At the beginning of the competition for the blood sword, half of the Jianghu forces in the five countries were mobilized. Needless to say, the entire army was wiped out.

But now, with the blood sword coming to the door, these local snakes, where would they let this piece of fat go, they all buzzed up like flies that smelled fishy.

Then there was another fight, and a winner was determined from it, and then the winner took the blood sword and sent it to Yu Yuguo.

Afterwards, there was another round of fighting, such killings, only the sky was darkened, and the universe was cleared, and the place within the Five Kingdoms was peaceful.

In the end, when the long sword was sent to the land of Yuguo and before entering Liaoyang City, it was only fifty miles away from the target Liaoyang City. The escorts had already lowered their vigilance, thinking that they had arrived at the place of Yuguo, and those people should not dare to make mistakes.

Who can think? Just twenty miles away from the official road of Liaoyang City, Liu Bang in front of him gathered hundreds of brothers under his command to intercept and kill those escorts.

Then those people had a tragedy. They fled all the way here, and their strength was greatly compromised. Many of them were injured, and they were exhausted, and their combat power was greatly reduced.

But now Liu Bang and others who are waiting for rabbits have hundreds of people, which is more than ten times that of those people. Among them are first-class masters like Fan Kuai and Zhou Bo, plus Liu Bang, there are three of them in total, their strength should not be underestimated.

So Liu Bang really succeeded, and no one else dared to make mistakes at the feet of the emperor of Yuguo, lest even if they got the blood sword, they would be taken down because they offended Yuguo's majesty.

At that time, not only did he lose countless lives, but he finally got what he wanted, but found that he couldn't exchange any rewards, and instead brought a catastrophe.

Therefore, despite the unwillingness of all the caring people, they still held back and did not dare to take any action, just quietly observing.

This also gave Liu Bang, a bold speculator, the opportunity to succeed in one fell swoop, and then meet the emperor in front of him.

That's why Liu Bang was obviously the winner and got back what he wanted for Zhong Yu, but he still looked terrified, because he was afraid that he would finally grab the braid and beat him to death.

After all, it is the fief of a county. If you can go back on your promise and have a legitimate reason to break your promise, who would not want to do it. At least Liu Bang himself would definitely do this.

It is no wonder that he is terrified when he judges others by himself.

"To the west of the state of Qin, there is a land of Gansu. It is the county of Xinna, our imperial state. It has an area of 1,500 miles and a population of more than 100,000. Let it be your fiefdom! Your country name is Liang State!" Zhong Yu pondered for a while, and gave Liu Bang such a reward.

Liu Bang has good luck. In this world, he has been favored by heaven and humanity, and everything he does is satisfactory.

Therefore, it is most appropriate to arrange him behind Qin State and use it to contain Qin State.

"Thank you for your majesty's gift. The guards of the Western Lands will be loyal to your majesty and the imperial country for generations!" Liu Bang was overjoyed when he heard the award, and finally couldn't maintain his panic and calmness, and hurriedly knelt down and thanked him excitedly.
